decisions.service_scope: Strip and repaint one steel cargo-bike frame using low-temperature rust-inhibiting enamel

commitments.detail: All stripping, painting, and curing processes will stay at or below 120°C to protect the brazed joints.
Use low-temperature rust-inhibiting enamel only; no powder coating.
Mira will refinish the frame in exchange for three sealed jars of homemade blackberry preserves and zero cash payment.
Evan will collect the finished frame on Sunday at 14:00.
Visible surface rust will be removed during the stripping process as part of the refinishing job.
